name: Downlink Data Rate
description: Achievable data rate from the satellite to the ground station. Checks whether science data volume can be downloaded.

elements.name: Achievable Downlink Rate
elements.description: Data rate during a ground station pass. Uncertain due to weather-induced attenuation and pointing loss.

uncertainty.source: Statistical link budget with weather availability

elements.name: Minimum Required Downlink Rate
elements.description: Minimum rate to close the science data budget per orbit

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(SNR_margin) = B · log2(1 + SNR_nominal · 10^(margin/10)); linearised: R ≈ R_nominal + α · margin_dB
consistency_relations.upr_description: Achievable data rate is a monotone function of the RF link margin, which itself is uncertain due to weather attenuation and pointing loss. A linearised parametric mapping propagates the link margin uncertainty through the Shannon capacity formula into the data rate domain, where it must exceed R_min = 20 Mbps.
